Name: Little Free Libraries
Author: tiakall
Description:
[i]I just [clenches fist] really love books, y'all....[/i]

This mod adds a Little Free Library in town near Lewis's house, with additional ones in Sunberry and Visit Mount Vapius if installed.  Drop any book into them, and come back the next day to receive a random book in return!  There is a config to select either Pelican Town style (red roof) or Mount Vapius style (blue roof).

Compatible with vanilla books, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Visit Mount Vapius[/url] books, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21526]Button's Extra Books[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30767]Profession Books[/url]!

Art done by the talented [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mrtaiyou]Taiyou[/url] - if you like his work, [url=https://ko-fi.com/ty_ty]send him a ko-fi![/url] Special thanks to Wildflour for help with troubleshooting and to 6480 for auditing my jank code.

If you didn't know: [url=https://littlefreelibrary.org/]Little Free Libraries[/url] are a real thing!  You can check their website to see if one is near you, or see about building one yourself!
